title: Al-'Alaq 96:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Qadr, Al-'Alaq 1 to 12 and the noon sakinah rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-'Alaq 96:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 12. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ (١) خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ (٢) ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ (٣) ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ (٤)

keywords.def: a clinging clot: how a baby begins

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-'Alaq 96:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 96:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 96:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write one way you can 'read in the name of your Lord' this week.
questions.a: For example: say Bismillah before reading my books and the Qur'an.

questions.q: 96:1 and 96:3 both start with the same word. Which word, and what does it mean?
In 96:4 Allah says He taught by means of ...
questions.a: A) the pen. 'Who taught by the pen' (96:4). The other answers are not in these ayat.

questions.q: Al-'Alaq 96:2: «خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: The very first word sent down to the Prophet ﷺ was 'Read!'. Why do you think Allah began with reading?
questions.a: Knowledge comes first: Allah taught by the pen (96:4). Muslims love to read and learn.
